Menu.name: Bot players
Menu.label: Bot Manager
Menu.hint: Add AI opponents: Jev bots, or chat-model bots with a personality (Recruit, Commander or Warlord). Connect the chat models, check the Jev relay, and pause or resume the bots.

relayUrl.name: Bots: Jev relay URL
relayUrl.hint: Where the GM's browser sends the bots' questions: the relay started with tools/jev-proxy/start-jev-relay.command on the GM's machine. The TypeSafe API key stays in the relay, never in Foundry.

relayToken.name: Bots: relay token
relayToken.hint: Optional. The same value as the relay's --token option, so other web pages can't use your relay.

model.name: Bots: Jev model
model.hint: The TypeSafe model the bots ask, e.g. jev-latest, or a pinned version such as jev-1.14.0.

pace.name: Bots: pace (ms)
pace.hint: Pause between a bot's visible actions, so everyone can follow. 0 plays as fast as possible.

reactionWindow.name: Bots: reaction window (s)
reactionWindow.hint: How long a bot attacker waits before rolling and before resolving when a person could still play a scar card or fire a missile.

narration.name: Bots: narration
narration.hint: Short chat lines explaining what each bot does and why.

onError.name: Bots: when Jev can't be reached
onError.hint: Pause and ask the GM, or carry on with the bots' built-in judgment (marked in the log and narration).

llmBaseUrl.name: Chat bots: API base URL
llmBaseUrl.hint: The OpenAI-compatible API the chat-model bots use: Nous Portal (https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1), or the local relay's http://127.0.0.1:30777/nous/v1 route, which keeps the API key out of the browser.

llmApiKey.name: Chat bots: API key
llmApiKey.hint: Set in the Bot Manager. Kept in this browser only, never in the world. Leave it empty when using the relay.

llmModel.name: Chat bots: default model
llmModel.hint: The model chat bots use unless the Bot Manager gives one its own, e.g. z-ai/glm-5.3.

llmTimeout.name: Chat bots: request timeout (s)
llmTimeout.hint: How long one chat-model request may take before it counts as failed. Reasoning models can take a while.

llmSpendLimit.name: Chat bots: spending cap per war ($)
llmSpendLimit.hint: The chat bots pause when their spend in the current war (the cost the API reports) reaches this many US dollars. 0 = no cap.

llmSpent.name: Chat bots: spend this war
llmSpent.hint: Kept by the bots: the current war's chat-model spend and number of calls.

tableTalk.name: Chat bots: table talk
tableTalk.hint: Short in-character lines the chat bots say at key moments.

Relay.thenTest: Leave it running, then press Test.
